description: Rhein-Kreis Neuss: Unfallatlas is a series of datasets listed in Open Data im Rhein-Kreis Neuss, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Statistische Ämter des Bundes und der Länder. Der interaktive Unfallatlas der Statistischen Ämter des Bundes und der Länder zeigt das Unfallgeschehen mit Personenschäden auf regionaler Ebene: Wo passieren in meiner Stadt die meisten Verkehrsunfälle? Nutzerinnen können im Unfallatlas nach Unfällen mit PKW-Beteiligung oder Krafträdern, Fahrrädern und Fußgängern filtern. Der Unfallatlas setzt dabei Open Data des Bundes und der Länder ein. Coverage: Rhein-Kreis Neuss. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per month, area, counter or year), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Traffic, Judiciary, legal system and public security. Its keywords are Unfälle, Straßenverkehrsunfälle. The portal shows 1,365 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Data licence Germany - Zero - Version 2.0 (http://dcat-ap.de/def/licenses/dl-zero-de/2.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-rhein-kreis-neuss-de-portal.
